findings.title: Node explicit authStrategy path fails every ZeroKMS request if protect-ffi 0.28 native does not unwrap the auth Result (or no longer accepts plain { token })
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: Rests on the unverified assumption that the native protect-ffi 0.28 newClient does not unwrap the Result (or rejects plain {token}); the finding admits protect-ffi source was unavailable.

findings.title: Stack's re-exported auth factories change runtime return shape under a 'minor' changeset, and shipped JSDoc still shows the old usage
findings.label: valid
findings.note: Stack re-exports auth strategies whose create() now returns a Result, yet the shipped JSDoc (encryption/index.ts, identity/index.ts, wasm-inline.ts) still passes create(...) directly as authStrategy, and the changeset does not call this out.

findings.title: Wizard reports an unexpected error instead of 'missing credentials' if auth 0.41's failure.type strings differ from the hard-coded ones
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: Same speculative literal-mismatch concern with no evidence that auth 0.41 uses different type strings; the changeset shows NOT_AUTHENTICATED is still used.
